record.dic_text:
0620 'Ocnappar {os-nap-par'}

源自外來語; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Asnappar 1; 1

亞斯那巴 = "有角的公牛"
1) 將人遷移到撒瑪利亞的亞述王, 可能就是歷史上的亞述巴尼帕 (#拉 4:10|)
record.edic_text:
0620 'Ocnappar {os-nap-par'}

of foreign derivation;; n pr m

AV - Asnappar 1; 1

Asnappar or Osnappar = "horned bull: thorn abolished"
1) an Assyrian king who transported other peoples into Samaria -
   probably the king, Ashurbanipal
